prompt:
Create the NEW production 2D RPG player side walk sheet, using the attached reference only for the exact existing student identity, angle and desired clean visual readability. This is a new animation. Redraw the complete head, neck, body, both arms and legs together in each cel, and put a realistic low-amplitude bob in the head and shoulders with continuous anatomy. Subject: same Chinese male university student, compact chibi RPG proportions, dark tousled black hair, warm face with clear eye, navy hooded jacket with thin pale shirt/zip line, black small backpack, dark charcoal trousers, gray-white sneakers. He faces RIGHT in every cell, seen in the same slightly elevated oblique profile as the reference, one near eye and slight sight of front chest, orthographic RPG map style. Keep costume and anatomical proportions, direction, silhouette width and lighting coherent over the entire family. 
Technical: transparent background, square overall sheet, EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 evenly centered non-overlapping whole student sprites, sufficient transparent gutters all around each sprite. No captions, numbers, rules, tile marks, extra objects, base tiles, shadows, text, axes, or UI. Draw each full body at consistent apparent size and eye style and same planted sole line relative to its own grid slot. Artwork looks like finely drawn hand-cleaned pixel art with actual hard-edged, dark thin linework on hair, neck, collar, hands, cuffs, pants and sneakers, stable grouped tonal clusters. Sharp at small game size. Black-dark charcoal hair with clear lighter strands, compact bright eye with readable eye contour, clear jaw/neck/collar separation using connected anatomy, blue jacket separated in value from charcoal backpack and trousers. Same 3/4-flat posture throughout, subtle volume, no smudged airbrush, blurry edges, edge halos, stipple, painterly gradients, motion blur, smeared face, vibrating outlines, outlines around the neck that detach head from body, color shifting, changing haircut or gear. Clean alpha cutout.
Grid playback, left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Cells 1–8 form one seamless ordinary relaxed walking cycle with two alternating foot contacts. Keep steps moderate, feet close to ground, arms swung opposite the corresponding legs. Cell 1 near leg forward heel contact and far leg behind, arms counter-swing, head at middle height. Cell 2 loading down: near foot carries weight and knee bends slightly, the far heel lifts, entire torso, shoulders and head slightly lower together. Cell 3 passing: far knee moves forward, feet almost cross, near leg planted beneath hip, arm swing passes center. Cell 4 rising: near heel lifts, far foot reaches forward for next contact, entire upper body slightly rises. Cell 5 far leg forward heel contact and near leg trailing, arm swing visibly swaps, head at middle height. Cell 6 far leg takes weight and body including head lowers gently, near heel lifts. Cell 7 passing, near leg swings through, far leg under hip, arms pass center. Cell 8 rising, near leg reaches forward, far heel lifts, shoulders and head rise very slightly; returns to cell 1 without snapping. Cell 9 neutral idle, both feet close and firmly planted, arms naturally relaxed. For the cycle, physically smooth steps, consistent face and hair mass with slight whole-body bob of around 2% total standing height (not fixed horizontal cut line), no independently shifted or pasted head, no running or marching. Same exact character with integrated neck connection in every cel.
